content:
incident-bot: PAGER: genqueue-high-latency - US-WEST - sev=P1 - pager: matt - runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/genqueue-high-latency
matt: Ack. I'm on it. Paging raj for observability.
matt: Investigating. Initial signal: increased 5xx from genqueue workers in US-WEST, ~1.8k errors/min. Routing fallback enabled to EU to reduce customer impact. No external notice published yet.
raj-observability: seeing spike correlated with KV-cache eviction around 2026-03-17T10:07Z. Quick tail from worker logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:07:12Z genqueue[worker-12] ERROR kv_cache miss rate 98% - OOM evict
2026-03-17T10:07:13Z genqueue[worker-12] 500 internal: cache lookup failed
```
samir: Draft statuspage snippet: "We are investigating reports of increased errors for generation requests in the US‑West region. Our engineers are actively investigating and have routed traffic to alternate regions to reduce impact. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
olivia-comm: please add affected customer segments if known and avoid ETA placeholders until we have one. Also include mitigation steps we took (reroute + cache bump).
jenna-legal: quick (legal) note: avoid speculative language and "reports of" — stick to observed facts. Replace "reports of" with "we are seeing" and remove ETA until we confirm.
samir: updated draft: "We are seeing increased error rates for generation requests in the US‑West region. Engineers have routed traffic to alternate regions to reduce customer impact. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
matt: +1 from oncall. Errors down ~60% after reroute and initial cache bump. Ready to publish initial status.
statuspage-bot: READY TO PUBLISH: Proposed message (unpublished):
---
We are seeing increased error rates for generation requests in the US‑West region. Engineers are investigating and have routed traffic to alternate regions to reduce customer impact. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.
---
Publish? Reply with /approve to proceed.
samir: publishing now.
statuspage-bot: PUBLISHED: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-17-genqueue-usw
olivia-comm: Published — sending targeted customer notifications to the affected customers list and updating the comms tracker.
raj-observability: update: KV-cache eviction rate improved after temporary cache size bump at 10:22Z; errors trending down but still above baseline.
matt: 15m update: Partial mitigation in place. Routing + cache bump reduced error rate ~75% vs peak. Still monitoring for full stabilization. ETA for full restore TBD.
olivia-comm: suggested customer update: "Partial mitigation is in place; we've routed traffic to alternate regions and applied a temporary cache increase. We're monitoring and expect restoration within the next hour." (requesting signoff)
jenna-legal: wording ok as long as we keep "expect" (not guaranteed).
statuspage-bot: UPDATE PUBLISHED: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-17-genqueue-usw#update-2
raj-observability: metrics are nominal on most nodes; a small subset had delayed cache warms.
matt: deploying permanent KV-cache config fix now. Will roll to all nodes and monitor.
raj-observability: metrics look stable for 20+ minutes after deploy on first batch. No new 5xx spikes.
samir: final publish (resolved) draft: "We have resolved the increased error rate affecting generation requests in US‑West. Root cause: KV-cache eviction due to incorrect size limits; a configuration fix was deployed. Customers may have experienced transient retries; a post-incident report will follow."
jenna-legal: approved.
statuspage-bot: RESOLVED PUBLISHED: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-17-genqueue-usw#resolved :white_check_mark:
matt: Thanks team — filing RCA draft and follow-up action items (config guardrails + alert on cache eviction rate).
olivia-comm: added to comms tracker, will send follow-up email to affected customers with RCA timeline.
samir: :thumbsup:
